title: License evidence
description: Reviewed license texts added to Go modules' /legal/go/pkg/mod/ directories so Syft sees every license their notices name (scripts/license-evidence.yaml).

as.description: File name at the top of the module's directory. It must be license-named, since that's all Syft reads, and must not replace an upstream file.

module.description: Go module path. The entry applies to every version of it in the image that has any of the reviewed files. Unique.

reason.description: What the upstream notice says, and why the added text is needed.

reviewed.description: The upstream files that were reviewed, by SHA-256. A module version whose file differs fails the build until the entry is reviewed again.

include.description: License texts the module itself ships where Syft doesn't look, copied to the top of its directory.

add.description: License texts the module doesn't ship, downloaded from a pinned upstream URL and checked against their SHA-256.
